text:
Alicia M: Quick sync — proposing token counter move into composer toolbar so users can monitor tokens while streaming. Proto: https://redwood.fig/streams/token-toolbar :eyes: Samir K: Good idea for visibility. Concern: rapid updates cause jitter. Suggest fixed-width pill + animate inner value. Collapse to icon-only while streaming. :thinking_face: Marta P: a11y: do NOT read every token update to SRs. Use aria-live=\"polite\" and debounce. Announce only: \"Generation started\", \"Generation stopped by user\", \"Generation complete — X tokens used\". Example snippet: ```html
Generation started
``` Also ensure token control has aria-label and visible focus ring for keyboard nav. Zoe L: UX: label the control \"Stop\" not \"Pause\" (pause implies resume). Tooltip: \"Stop generation — partial result kept. Esc\". Show keyboard hint on hover. Samir K: Shortcuts: Esc = stop, R = regenerate, Cmd/Ctrl+Enter = submit. Add these to help overlay. Alicia M: Counter modes: compact (icon + short num), expanded (used / cap + est remaining). Streaming -> icon-only to reduce clutter. Tooltip shows breakdown: prompt vs response estimate. Marta P: Implementation note: reserve pill width to avoid layout shifts. CSS idea: `.token-pill { width:70px; display:inline-flex; justify-content:center; }` Animate digits only. Zoe L: Contrast issue: small token text needs 4.5:1. I'll upload swatches and three placement mocks (left/right/inline) for a quick 6-person preference test tomorrow. designbot: Preview: https://playground-preview.red/ui/1766001111 includes compact pill, keyboard hints, and stop snackbar. Leave comments in #design-test. Samir K: When user hits Stop, show a subtle snackbar: \"Generation stopped — partial result available. Press R to regenerate.\" Helps reduce confusion. Alicia M: Also adding a tiny quick-insert (last-used system prompt) near pill for power users. If it opens a dialog, ensure focus trap and Escape returns focus to composer. Marta P: Quick-insert dialog should have role=dialog, aria-labelledby and focus trap. Escape closes and returns focus. Zoe L: If no objections, I plan to land compact pill on the right of toolbar and set tab order: composer -> token pill -> send. Posting Figma variants + micro-interaction specs by EOD. Alicia M: Next steps: Zoe posts Figma + contrast swatches, Marta writes aria spec with exact strings, Samir wires shortcuts in prototype, I'll draft tooltip + snackbar copy. :thumbsup:
